title: kate-lsp: build and read completion requests
summary: completion_params builds the textDocument/completion parameters. completion_labels reads the response: a CompletionList or an array, each item with its label and the text to insert from insertText, textEdit.newText, or the label. A snippet item inserts its label.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Read result.items when result is an object, else result as an array. insert_text is textEdit.newText, else insertText, else label; when insertTextFormat is 2 the label is used. The test completion_labels_read_both_shapes asserts {"isIncomplete": false, "items": [{"label": "a", "insertText": "a()"}]} gives one label a with insert a(), that [{"label": "b", "insertTextFormat": 2, "insertText": "b($1)"}] gives insert b, and null gives an empty list. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: requests::tests::completion_labels_read_both_shapes
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because completion_labels does not exist. After the change both result shapes give labels and a snippet inserts its label.
